name: m4-unreachable-ab
description: Timing and allocation A/B of retronym/scala#200 at `bc2406ed31` against its base, with an A/A as the noise floor: `aa` is a second build of the same commit as `base`. Repeats `m5-unreachable-ab` on the current head, on a second machine. Compare within this campaign only. m4 has been reported running warm, so time is to be read with care; allocation should not be affected.

Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); corpora compiled plainly, where unreachable-code removal is the only optimiser pass on. Patched JDK 26, 8G heap. scala: single-shot 4+4 ops; scalap: 20+20 x 2 s. Builds alternate fork by fork over 5 rounds.

variantDescriptions.aa: the same commit as `base`, for the noise floor
